title: Maybe my cat is just too picky...
text: I was excited as this was my first subscription box I tried for my kitty, and with all the good reviews, I thought it’d be a sure hit! Unfortunately, my cat didn’t care for any of the toys and she didn’t like the freeze dried treats it came with, either. Maybe she’s just too picky. The value was OKAY, but considering what this company does for each box bought, I think it’d be worthwhile *IF* your cat actually enjoys the toys/treats. Very cute packaging.
label: neutral
